claim_scope: Binary length-seven codes correcting either exactly one deletion or at most one adjacent transposition, with distinct output lengths distinguished; 28 labeled size-16 optimal codes in 8 reversal/complement orbits.
scientific_integrity: Finite counts reproduced by two independent exhaustive enumeration algorithms with direct-output and bitmask graph constructions. No infinite extrapolation or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result for n=7 only. The symmetry group consists only of global coordinate reversal and bit complement. An unindexed prior complete enumeration is a residual bibliography risk. No claims about joint sequential edit patterns or general n.
title: Equality classification of seven-bit codes correcting a deletion or adjacent transposition
